memberships.page_title: Filtered Finite-Jet Realization at the Plane Boundary
A Stored Degree-21 Terminal Model Does Not Glue

statement: After the canonical k=4 rechart and forced adjacent-chart condition, the complete layer-five-through-seven support and chart-matching equations of the stored degree-21 full-support terminal specialization have no solution over the algebraic closure of its quintic coefficient field.
title: The Stored Degree-21 Terminal Model Is Excluded Through Layer Seven
